scope_entries.finding: the domain is chosen only by the `X-Lobes-Model: decider:<domain>` header (missing or bare decider = general; regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`); the gateway forwards the body byte-identical and never reads model; a domain not served locally is forwarded once to the mesh member announcing it, the reply naming it in X-Lobes-Mesh-Member

the sidecar requires model, state and a non-empty questions object, each type noul|choice|score, choice/score with non-empty criteria, no images/videos; DECIDER_MAX_MODEL_LEN 16384 tokens, an over-long schema is 422; the response is {model, answers{...}, usage{input_tokens, output_tokens}} passed through unreshaped

errors: 404 model_not_found / role_infeasible, 503 backend_unavailable (Retry-After 5), 503 loading, 500 failed, 422 validation, 409 decider_domain_conflict, 503 role_unverified, 508 a second hop, 401 bad key; the decider is never shed (no 429 from pressure)

the skill's client: X-Lobes-Model header, default model clef, 120 s timeout, requires instructions on each question and at least 2 criteria for non-noul types; reads answers, usage.input_tokens and X-Lobes-Mesh-Member

the port pattern to copy: injectable transport (no proxies, no redirects, capped response), grant-only api_key resolved at call time, base_url checks, not_after + refuse_before_admit, ReplayLedger replay of completed results, code: detail failures that never carry a body or secret

ENDPOINT_KINDS is (llm.complete, audio.transcribe); an agent actor with params.base_url is an endpoint actor and model_taken applies when another enabled endpoint actor has the same model; joining ENDPOINT_KINDS makes repoint-actor require an endpoint target
ActorRouter wraps every action naming params.actor in LimitedActor with that actor's concurrency_pool / max_concurrency; tokens_of counts output.usage.total_tokens against a token_budget

a step's when reads only its own input ports; field paths walk nested dicts and compare numbers with < <= > >=; a missing path is false so the step is skipped silently; ports are declared statically and may be type object, so one object port answers wired into a later step is the workable design
ACTION_WORDS needs an entry (a test lists every kind); a new action kind cannot trip the c9 paragraph fallback, which is about unknown step kinds and invalid config

the editor's action catalog is a hand-kept TS copy: the ActionKind union, the picker's params/label catalog and the actorsFor switch (llm.complete and audio.transcribe offer agent actors with a base_url)
